# port-owner

Which process listens on a TCP port: pid and name, so one dev server can be stopped alone.

| Param | Type | Required | Default | Help |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--port` | int | yes |  | TCP port |
| `--netstat` | path | no | `""` | Parse this saved netstat -ano output instead of asking the OS |

Run it from the repo root:

```
caveman-blocks run port-owner --port <int>
```

It prints one JSON object with the keys port, listening, owners.

Without the CLI, `python3 .blocks/port-owner.py --port <int>` runs the same file, but nothing is enforced: no effects gate, no path confinement, no output cap.
